statements.status_notes: containerd/v2 2.3.4 is statically embedded in /usr/bin/dockerd and the docker-buildx and docker-compose CLI plugins from current docker-ce packages used by sbx-templates Docker variants. The standalone containerd.io package is already at 2.3.5, but remediation for this finding requires docker-ce (and related plugins) to rebuild against containerd/v2 2.3.5 or later.
